BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Fey, Jinkins, Sawyer, and Kirby

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Local Government.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Relating to the petition-based annexation method for owners of property within a city or town that seek annexation to another city or town.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the petition-based annexation method for owners of property within a city or town that seek annexation to another city or town.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act shall be known as the petition-based municipality annexation act of 2015.
